title: Complete Proforma Invoice workflow
description: Implement the documented Proforma Invoice (PI) batch end-to-end: PI main/detail persistence, numbering, quotation-to-PI conversion, CRUD, audit/unaudit/void behavior consistent with project conventions, list/edit UI, menu entry, printing/template integration, and regression tests. Changes to SchemaUpgrader are code changes validated only against NEWERP_TEST; production deployment remains gated.
acceptance_criteria: ProformaInvoice and detail are persisted with PI number/date, source quotation, customer/contact, consignee/notify party, shipping marks, bank info, trade/payment/shipping terms, currency/exchange rate, totals, deposit ratio/amount, salesman, status, remark and line items.

Quotation can be converted to a PI exactly once per intended conversion rule, copying business fields/details and recording source quotation; invalid source status is rejected with a clear business error.
PI supports create/read/update plus approve and unaudit with server-side amount recalculation and safe status validation.
PI appears in the intended menu and is usable from the web UI; list, edit, quotation-to-PI action and printing work in Microsoft Edge.
Document number rules include PI without breaking existing numbering.
Unit/integration tests cover conversion, amount/deposit calculation, invalid state and persistence; existing tests remain green.
Real Edge acceptance captures at least quotation -> PI -> open PI -> print preview flow and passes before completion.

scenarios: Login in Microsoft Edge and open the quotation list; create or use a valid quotation and execute 转 PI.
Open the generated PI and verify copied customer, terms, currency, line items, totals and deposit values.
Edit a draft PI, save, approve, verify approved PI cannot be edited until unaudit, then unaudit and verify editing is restored.
Open PI print preview and verify the document renders without console errors or failed API requests.

human_gate.reason: User explicitly requested completion of all project functions. Schema changes are restricted to code and NEWERP_TEST validation; production deployment/database operations remain separately gated.
